During the verification of the amount of candy available in the reserve tank, the presence of a foreign material inside the tank was detected.
The kitchen leader and supervisor were immediately notified of the finding. As a preventive measure, the shipment of candy to the deposit was suspended and the contents of the tank were drained in order to identify and recover the foreign material.
During drainage, it was possible to identify the object as a soft plastic material.
Subsequently, the Maintenance personnel were notified to determine the possible origin of the material. Maintenance indicated that it could not determine its origin, because this type of material is not normally used or found in that area.
The foreign material was identified and separated for evaluation. Communication was maintained with the departments involved to determine the possible origin of the FM and prevent a possible recurrence.
